title: Investigating and Mitigating Stereotype-aware Unfairness in LLM-based Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the calibration of gender-stereotyped item recommendations against a user's historical interaction proportions using the MovieLens dataset, and evaluating fairness under implicit, explicit, and counterfactual prompt settings.

Measuring the calibration of age-stereotyped item recommendations (teen vs. adult groups) against a user's historical interaction proportions using the BookCrossing dataset, and evaluating fairness under implicit, explicit, and counterfactual prompt settings.
